decisions.summary: Row knots.py::next_gather#knots no lawful gather reaches closed as FIXED by door_end_teed: an access lane's lone door end (end 0, alone at its node, on no other lane's side) with the other point on that same lane is no knot, asked by both the gather search (knots via _teed_pair) and the verdict (lane_knots, read by the pool test and the cohort)
decisions.why: It narrows the literal reach of 0081's 'ends within 25 ft are joined at a single point', and is the exception spec-fidelity ruled LEGITIMATE in a narrow form on 2026-10-10. Conditions 1-4 checked against the diff: (1) door_end_teed returns True only for end 0 of an ACCESS lane, alone, its point on no other lane, the other point on its own polyline; both call sites encode the end as the code builds it (lane_knots: 0 if x % 2 == 0 else -1). (2) A lone door end on no other lane is by construction not a junction, so no junction pair is exempted; three lanes arriving (two feet on lane i near its door end) still knot on the feet's own pair; the new test pins the loose-end and junction cases. (3) One predicate, both sites. (4) Re-measured this round: make cohort N=48 52/54, refused only 10 and 20 (WebRefused), no lane_knots failure (wave 93: 38/54, 14 knotted); make test-file test_pool_261.py 42 passed, 1 xfailed (the zigzag list, unrelated); Sawada rerolled with the diff, tree unchanged. The purpose of the rule - three lanes never arriving a few feet apart - is not reached by a two-lane T near a door, which one drawn lane already joins (the module docstring's own reading).

decisions.summary: No Decisions Recorded row in spec.md for the exception, on the grounds that no map's drawing changes
decisions.why: FR-008 records every fix that changes what a map draws OR STATES, in its class, in spec.md's Decisions Recorded, added by the wave's amendment. This wave changes the generator's own rule for what is a lawful drawing: the gather search (knots) no longer tries to gather these pairs, so what a roll draws can change (wave 92's measurement showed the gather-side exemption changing outcomes), and a configuration the ranking called a DRIFTED defect is now drawn as lawful on 14 cohort seeds and Sawada. 'No pool map moved' is not FR-008's test: the table already carries wave 16 rows whose Why says 'it moved nothing drawn', and amendment 79 round 1 was BLOCKED on exactly this omission. It is also an XVI exception, which the table's first row names as the only path by which the reading of the research moves, and the caller's own statement of condition 5 places it in the spec's Decisions. The exception check of 2026-10-10 itself also has no line in spec.md's review history (the 2026-10-08 MODE 1 check does), so its five conditions exist only as summaries. Fix: add a Decisions Recorded row (decision: a household way's lone door end teed on its own lane is no knot; class: the XVI exception reading of 0081, ruled LEGITIMATE in a narrow form by spec-fidelity 2026-10-10, to be raised with the GM; why: one drawn lane joins the two, three lanes do not arrive; recorded at hamletgen/ways/knots.py door_end_teed, m:wave94-door-end-teed) and a review-history line recording the 2026-10-10 exception check and its conditions.
